details: The cryptocurrency market experienced nearly $2 billion in liquidations over the past 24 hours, the largest since February 5, with short liquidations accounting for $1.75 billion. This surge was primarily driven by a surprise announcement from the US Treasury to double its long-term bond buyback operations, which lowered yields and renewed risk-on sentiment. Bitcoin gained over 5% to reach $68,000, and Ethereum jumped 9% past $2,000.
title: Crypto Market Sees $2 Billion in Liquidations as US Treasury Buybacks Spark Short Squeeze

details: Bitcoin is targeting $70,000 after a 7% rise, fueled by the US Treasury's decision to double long-term bond buybacks, which has improved market liquidity and sentiment. Ethereum, Hyperliquid (HYPE), and Official Trump (TRUMP) tokens have all recorded double-digit gains within the last 24 hours, signaling a potential renewed bull run across the broader crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Eyes $70,000 Amidst US Treasury Bond Buybacks; ETH, HYPE, TRUMP Lead Gains

details: On August 19, 2026, former President Donald Trump held a White House meeting with crypto CEOs, where discussions included the possibility of the US acquiring Bitcoin reserves. This comes as the US national debt reached a staggering $40.049 trillion. Trump emphasized his administration's support for the crypto industry, stating they ended the "war on crypto."
title: Trump Discusses Bitcoin Reserves as US Debt Exceeds $40 Trillion

details: Binance's security team successfully detected and helped prevent a malicious governance proposal targeting an unnamed Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO). The attack could have put approximately $1.2 million in treasury tokens at risk. Binance coordinated with the affected project and other exchanges to close deposits, leading to the proposal's rejection within 48 hours.
title: Binance Prevents $1.2M Governance Attack on Unnamed DAO

details: Ripple is expanding its institutional footprint, including securing a South Korean banking deal and its prime brokerage, Ripple Prime, raising $275 million in senior unsecured notes. Despite these institutional advancements, XRP's price has seen a recent dip to $0.98 before recovering above $1.00, leading traders to anticipate a significant price movement.
title: Ripple Secures Institutional Wins, XRP Traders Await Larger Move

details: XRP's on-chain trading volume is increasingly concentrated during the overlapping business hours of London and New York, with a three-hour window accounting for 23.5% of weekday volume in July 2026, up from 14.3% a year prior. This trend suggests growing institutional interest and increased activity during traditional financial market hours.
title: XRP On-Chain Trading Volume Concentrates During London-New York Overlap

details: Hyperliquid (HYPE) surged over 13% following President Trump's announcement that the CFTC is working to bring the decentralized exchange into the US in a compliant manner. This bullish sentiment was amplified by Coinbase's Base App integrating Hyperliquid-powered perpetuals, along with a broader market short squeeze.
title: Hyperliquid Surges After Trump's CFTC Comment and Coinbase Integration

details: Cardano (ADA) saw a 10.02% increase on August 19, reaching $0.1903 on the Investing.com Index. This marked its largest one-day percentage gain since July 3, pushing its market cap to $6.8874 billion amid a broader bullish trend in the cryptocurrency market.
title: Cardano Climbs 10% in Bullish Trade

details: Solana is implementing a change to its per-block compute limits to accommodate a new 350-millisecond target slot time, down from 400ms. This adjustment aims to prevent network overload while enhancing speed and latency, with the mainnet target taking effect in epoch 1020.
title: Solana Slashes Per-Block Compute Limits for 350ms Speed Boost
